Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy until you feel a light, pleasant tingling in your ear. 
Then just go about your day. You can read, work, meditate, or relax while using it. 
How long to use it
Start with 15–60 minutes per session
Many people use it daily for 30–60 minutes, often in the morning or split between morning and evening. 
Tip: the sensation should always feel comfortable — not strong or painful.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.
